purpose: Upgrade the 42 Canon research actions from noninstitutional photo leads to a CMAA-credited 1962-Vatican-labelled printed page source; preserve independent edition, action glyph and actual priest clock release holds.

provenance.scanCredit: Scans courtesy of the Church Music Association of America
provenance.disclaimer: GregoBase source 42 includes photographed title page (Editio typica), 23 June 1962 decree identifying Vatican publishing/presses, and Ritus IX.1 on image 64 in the same indexed image series. This directly improves edition-internal provenance over an isolated scan. The exact physical copy, binding/colophon chain and independent library authentication remain unverified; the printed cross's shape at low resolution and real priest action timing remain unapproved. No image is imported or relicensed into the public app.
